rationale: The assistant followed the ideal path: isolate power, turn the drum by hand, then interpret the free-spinning drum, 'twang' and visible black rubber strip as a snapped drive belt, matching the hidden truth without any fabrication. It correctly declined to name a part number on the partial 'TVHM8' model and offered to help find the full number. Weaknesses: the final turn defaults to 'contact an engineer' without asking whether the customer is comfortable removing panels (they had tools and were willing), it drops the earlier mention of the tension/jockey pulley when it would be sensible to inspect or replace it alongside the belt, and it does not point to the back-panel rating plate as an alternative location for the full model/serial.
